package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_returns_gorm_query_builder: Repositories that return partially built `*gorm.DB` chains for callers to finish.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Comment struct {
	ID      uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	PostID  uint   `gorm:"index"`
	Author  string `gorm:"size:128"`
	Body    string `gorm:"type:text"`
	Flagged bool   `gorm:"default:false"`
}

type CommentRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewCommentRepo(db *gorm.DB) *CommentRepo {
	return &CommentRepo{db: db}
}

func (r *CommentRepo) QueryForPost(postID uint) *gorm.DB {
	return r.db.Model(&Comment{}).Where("post_id = ?", postID).Where("flagged = ?", false)
}

func (r *CommentRepo) QueryByAuthor(author string) *gorm.DB {
	return r.db.Model(&Comment{}).Where("author = ?", author).Order("id DESC")
}

func (r *CommentRepo) QueryRecent() *gorm.DB {
	return r.db.Model(&Comment{}).Order("id DESC").Limit(50)
}

var _ = gorm.ErrRecordNotFound
